items.sentence: According to [MASK], Supervisor denied his request to attend a concert with his daughter. [YOB: 1982; no prior EEO activity; national origin unknown]) to adjust DO 1’s schedule.
Supervisor asserted that on [MASK], Complainant requested via text, to adjust his schedule to 0500 to 1300 hours to attend a recreational event.
[MASK] recalled that Complainant informed him via text that Complainant would take leave; however, Supervisor stated, Complainant decided to report to work.
On [MASK], Complainant was in an all-day Defensive Tactics training class scheduled from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Complainant asserted that on [MASK], he became aware of pay discrepancies made by Supervisor.
